title: Account Creation
subtitle: Create your TaraHive account to start planning and managing your trips.

blocks.text: A TaraHive account allows you to securely store your itineraries, synchronize your data across devices, collaborate with other travelers, and access personalized features such as AI recommendations and weather updates.

blocks.caption: Benefits of creating a TaraHive account

blocks.text: Follow these steps to register using your email address.

items: On the Welcome screen, select "Create Account".
Read and accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

blocks.text: Use an email address that you can access, as it may be required for account verification and password recovery.
You can also create an account quickly using your Google account.

items: Select "Continue with Google" on the Welcome screen.
Complete any remaining profile information if prompted.

blocks.text: Depending on your account settings, TaraHive may send a verification email to confirm your email address before you can access all features.

items: Locate the verification email from TaraHive.
Open the email and select the verification link.
Sign in using your newly created account.

blocks.text: If you do not receive the verification email within a few minutes, check your Spam or Junk folder.
After creating your account, you can personalize your profile to improve your experience within TaraHive.

items: Set your preferred language and region.

blocks.text: Congratulations! Your TaraHive account has been created successfully. You can now begin creating itineraries, collaborating with other users, and exploring the application's features.
Keep your login credentials secure and never share your password with others.
